controlPointType: external named-town symbol audit; not exact surveyed surviving-feature control
coordinateConvention: Native raster pixels measured from upper-left; svg is nativePixel / 4 for the parent quarter raster. lnglat is copied from Natural Earth, not inferred from the printed grid.

referenceDataset.use: Control-point coordinates only; no published geometry.

method: Predicted crop locations from the parent graticule approximation; visually read printed named town symbols in full-resolution source crops. Pixel prediction was not used as the final coordinate. Excluded unproven identities and large blue circles. No fit or residual calculated here; parent should fit these independent observations and label its external results separately from internal grid precision.

rejectedCandidates.name: Batu Pahat

rejectedCandidates.name: Raub

rejectedCandidates.name: Kelang

knownGaps: These controls compare persistent named towns to generalized Natural Earth city points. They do not independently prove the exact coordinate of a surviving 1898 street junction or surveyed feature.
The 2.5 km correspondence allowance is a conservative declared uncertainty, not a measured NE accuracy or a derived error bound. Do not treat it as a residual.
Built-up-symbol centres involve interpretation; uncertainty is recorded per point in native pixels. The printed town symbol is not a municipal territory polygon.
Do not describe a fitted low RMS as metre-level external accuracy. The source geodetic datum and map compilation accuracy remain unidentified.
No Borneo coverage. No source grid coordinates were used as the reference longitude/latitude for these controls.
